queer_characters.name: Chiron
queer_characters.notes: Central character across three life stages; his sexuality is treated with tenderness and complexity rather than tragedy for its own sake.

queer_characters.name: Kevin
queer_characters.notes: Ambiguous but central romantic connection to Chiron across decades.

queer_creators.name: Tarell Alvin McCraney
queer_creators.notes: Wrote the semi-autobiographical source play, 'In Moonlight Black Boys Look Blue'; screenplay credited to McCraney and director Barry Jenkins.

contributor_notes: Won Best Picture at the 89th Academy Awards. Adapted from Tarell Alvin McCraney's semi-autobiographical play; McCraney is publicly gay, so own-voices tag reflects the source material's authorship.
